long_biography.plain_text:
Software executive Michael Kohlsdorf was leading LogMeIn when it relaunched as GoTo in 2022, combining communications and IT support in one application. The change followed a year of development and centred on tools that small and medium-sized businesses could administer together. His tenure as chief executive lasted from January to August, when the company promoted its product and technology chief, Paddy Srinivasan, to succeed him.

Taking temporary executive assignments is part of Kohlsdorf’s work with Francisco Partners’ operating team, which coaches technology businesses and supplies interim leadership. He had worked closely with Srinivasan for several years and credited him with developing GoTo’s product strategy. After the handover, Kohlsdorf continued on the company’s board.
long_biography.html:
Software executive Michael Kohlsdorf was leading LogMeIn when it relaunched as GoTo in 2022, combining communications and IT support in one application. The change followed a year of development and centred on tools that small and medium-sized businesses could administer together. His tenure as chief executive lasted from January to August, when the company promoted its product and technology chief, Paddy Srinivasan, to succeed him.

Taking temporary executive assignments is part of Kohlsdorf’s work with Francisco Partners’ operating team, which coaches technology businesses and supplies interim leadership. He had worked closely with Srinivasan for several years and credited him with developing GoTo’s product strategy. After the handover, Kohlsdorf continued on the company’s board.
